description: This file provides utility functions for encryption and decryption using CryptoJS, focusing on AES-128-ECB mode. It includes functions for handling tenant ID encryption, string encryption/decryption, and helper functions that wrap these operations with safety considerations.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES-128-ECB with a SHA256-derived key and returns a Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a Base64 encrypted string using AES-128-ECB with a SHA256-derived key, restoring the original string.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID using the predefined tenant salt.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted tenant ID, returning null if decryption fails.

methods.name: encryptString
methods.description: Encrypts any string with the tenant salt.

methods.name: decryptStringClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt a clipboard value; returns original if decryption fails.

methods.name: encryptedTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts the ROOT_TENANT_ID for external use.

methods.name: getRootTenantId
methods.description: Returns the static ROOT_TENANT_ID environment variable.
